name: Md Shahrukh Anjum
bio: Md Shahrukh Anjum is an Assistant Professor at the Amrut Mody School of Management. His primary research interest centers around Operations Research, Combinatorial Optimisation and Analytics. He is interested in introducing structured approaches to solve difficult combinatorial optimisation problems pertaining to network design, finding applications in supply chain, telecommunication and satellite scheduling. He has completed his PhD from the Decision Sciences Department at the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIMB) and his B-Tech from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT-ISM) Dhanbad.
